Declared and unpaid dividend = 2,000 shares × $5 = $10,000.

The $20,000 secured-creditor statement is wrong on both points: the second year's undeclared dividend is not a liability, and a declared dividend is unsecured. The statement that Price has priority over the bond owners is wrong because bondholders are creditors whose claims are paid before shareholders' claims as owners. The statement that Price has priority over the unsecured judgment creditors is wrong because, as to the $10,000 declared dividend, Price shares equally with other general unsecured creditors and has no priority over them; as to the undeclared arrearage, Price ranks below all creditors.
questions.explanationJa:
現金配当は宣言（declare）された時点で会社の債務となり、宣言済み・未払いの金額について株主は無担保債権者になります（RMBCA §6.40(f)：分配に係る債務は一般の無担保債権者と同順位）。一方、宣言されていない配当は、累積的優先株であっても会社の債務ではありません。未払いの累積配当は、将来の分配や清算時に普通株主より優先して受け取れる権利にすぎません。

宣言済み・未払いの配当 = 2,000株 × $5 = $10,000

「担保付債権者として $20,000」は二重に誤りで、2年目の宣言されていない配当は債務ではなく、宣言済みの配当も無担保です。「社債権者より優先する」も誤りで、社債権者は債権者であり、出資者である株主より先に弁済を受けます。「無担保の判決債権者より優先する」も誤りで、宣言済みの $10,000 については他の一般無担保債権者と同順位であり優先権はありません。未宣言の累積配当はすべての債権者より劣後します。
questions.source: Proactive REG テキスト Business Entities Q.15

questions.stem: Which of the following actions may be taken by a corporation's board of directors without stockholder approval?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Purchasing substantially all of the assets of another corporation

choices.label: B
choices.text: Selling substantially all of the corporation's assets

choices.label: C
choices.text: Dissolving the corporation

choices.label: D
choices.text: Amending the articles of incorporation

questions.explanation:
Under RMBCA §8.01(b), the business and affairs of a corporation are managed by or under the direction of its board of directors. Purchasing substantially all of the assets of another corporation is an ordinary acquisition from the buyer's standpoint; the buyer's shareholders' interests are not fundamentally changed, so the board may approve it without a shareholder vote. (It is the selling corporation's shareholders who must approve.)

Selling substantially all of the corporation's assets other than in the usual course of business requires shareholder approval if it would leave the corporation without a significant continuing business activity (RMBCA §12.02). Dissolving the corporation requires the board to adopt a proposal of dissolution and the shareholders to approve it (RMBCA §14.02). Amending the articles of incorporation generally requires a board resolution followed by shareholder approval (RMBCA §10.03), except for certain minor amendments listed in §10.05. These are fundamental changes that require shareholder approval.
questions.explanationJa:
RMBCA §8.01(b) により、会社の業務は取締役会（またはその指揮の下）で行われます。他社の資産のほぼすべてを購入することは、買い手側から見れば通常の取得取引であり、買い手の株主の地位に根本的な変化は無いので、株主の承認なしに取締役会だけで決められます（株主の承認が必要なのは売り手側の会社です）。

通常の業務以外で自社の資産のほぼすべてを売却し、重要な事業が残らなくなる場合は株主の承認が必要です（§12.02）。会社の解散は、取締役会が解散案を採択し株主が承認する必要があります（§14.02）。定款の変更も、§10.05 の軽微な変更を除き、取締役会の決議の後に株主の承認が必要です（§10.03）。これらはいずれも基礎的変更（fundamental changes）です。
questions.source: Proactive REG テキスト Business Entities Q.17

questions.stem: Jane Cox, a shareholder of Mix Corp., has properly commenced a derivative action against Mix's Board of Directors. Cox alleges that the Board breached its fiduciary duty and was negligent by failing to independently verify the financial statements prepared by management upon which Smart & Co., CPAs, issued an unqualified opinion. The financial statements contained inaccurate information which the Board relied upon in committing large sums of money to capital expansion. This resulted in Mix having to borrow money at extremely high interest rates to meet current cash needs. Within a short period of time, the price of Mix Corp. stock declined drastically. Which of the following statements is correct?

choices.label: A
choices.text: The Board is strictly liable, regardless of fault, since it owes a fiduciary duty to both the corporation and the shareholders.

choices.label: B
choices.text: The Board is liable since any negligence of Smart is automatically imputed to the Board.

choices.label: C
choices.text: The Board may avoid liability if it acted in good faith and in a reasonable manner.

choices.label: D
choices.text: The Board may avoid liability in all cases where it can show that it lacked scienter.

questions.explanation:
Under RMBCA §8.30(a)–(b), directors must act in good faith, in a manner they reasonably believe to be in the best interests of the corporation, and with the care that a person in a like position would reasonably believe appropriate. In doing so, a director is entitled to rely on financial statements and other information prepared or presented by officers whom the director reasonably believes to be reliable and competent, and by public accountants as to matters within their professional competence (RMBCA §8.30(d)–(f)). Under this standard and the business judgment rule, the Board may avoid liability if it acted in good faith and in a reasonable manner; it had no duty to independently verify audited financial statements absent knowledge that reliance was unwarranted.

The strict-liability statement is wrong because directors are not insurers of corporate results; liability requires a breach of the standards of conduct (RMBCA §8.31). The statement that Smart's negligence is automatically imputed to the Board is wrong because the auditor is an independent professional, not the Board's agent, and the Board may rely on the auditor's work. The scienter statement is wrong because lack of scienter (intent to deceive) is a defense to fraud, not to negligence; directors who fail to exercise reasonable care may be liable even without scienter, so it does not protect them in all cases.
questions.explanationJa:
RMBCA §8.30(a)〜(b) により、取締役は誠実に（in good faith）、会社の最善の利益になると合理的に信じる方法で、同じ立場の者が適切と考える注意をもって職務を行わなければなりません。その際、信頼できると合理的に考える役員が作成した財務諸表や、公認会計士の専門的な意見には依拠できます（§8.30(d)〜(f)）。この基準と経営判断原則により、取締役会が誠実かつ合理的に行動していれば責任を免れることができます。依拠が不当だと知っていない限り、監査済みの財務諸表を独自に検証する義務はありません。

「過失を問わず厳格責任を負う」は誤りで、取締役は結果を保証する者ではなく、責任を負うのは行為基準に違反した場合だけです（§8.31）。「Smart の過失が自動的に取締役会に帰属する」も誤りで、監査人は取締役会の代理人ではない独立の専門家であり、取締役会はその仕事に依拠できます。「scienter（欺罔の意図）が無ければどんな場合も責任を免れる」も誤りで、scienter の欠如は詐欺に対する抗弁であって過失に対する抗弁ではありません。合理的な注意を怠れば、意図が無くても責任を負うことがあります。
questions.source: Proactive REG テキスト Business Entities Q.18

questions.stem:
Under the Revised Model Business Corporation Act, a dissenting stockholder's appraisal right generally applies to which of the following corporate actions?

Consolidations | Short-form mergers

choices.label: A
choices.text: Yes | Yes

choices.label: B
choices.text: Yes | No

choices.label: C
choices.text: No | Yes

choices.label: D
choices.text: No | No

questions.explanation:
Under RMBCA §13.02(a)(1), a shareholder is entitled to appraisal rights (to dissent and obtain payment of the fair value of the shares) in the event of a merger to which the corporation is a party if shareholder approval is required, and also when the corporation is a subsidiary that is merged with its parent under the short-form merger procedure (RMBCA §11.05). A consolidation, in which two or more corporations combine into a newly formed corporation, is a fundamental change that requires approval of each combining corporation's shareholders; under the current RMBCA it is carried out as a merger into a new entity, and dissenting shareholders have appraisal rights (Yes).

In a short-form merger, the parent owning at least 90% of the subsidiary's voting shares may merge the subsidiary without a vote of the subsidiary's shareholders. Because those minority shareholders have no vote, appraisal is their remedy, so appraisal rights apply (Yes).

The combination is therefore Yes | Yes. Any combination answering No for consolidations or short-form mergers is wrong because both are fundamental changes that trigger appraisal rights for dissenting shareholders.
questions.explanationJa:
RMBCA §13.02(a)(1) により、株主の承認が必要な合併では、反対株主は株式の公正な価格での買取りを求める権利（appraisal right）を持ちます。また、親会社が略式合併（short-form merger、§11.05）で子会社を吸収する場合も、子会社の株主に appraisal right があります。

新設合併（consolidation）は2社以上が新会社に統合される基礎的変更で、各社の株主の承認が必要です。現行の RMBCA では新設会社への合併として行われ、反対株主には appraisal right があります（Yes）。略式合併は、子会社の議決権株式の90%以上を持つ親会社が、子会社株主の決議なしに行える合併です。少数株主には議決権が無いので、appraisal right が救済手段になります（Yes）。

したがって組合せは Yes | Yes です。
questions.source: Proactive REG テキスト Business Entities Q.19

questions.stem: Which of the following must take place for a corporation to be voluntarily dissolved?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Passage by the board of directors of a resolution to dissolve

choices.label: B
choices.text: Approval by the officers of a resolution to dissolve

choices.label: C
choices.text: Amendment of the certificate of incorporation

choices.label: D
choices.text: Unanimous vote of the stockholders

questions.explanation:
Under RMBCA §14.02, a corporation's board of directors may propose dissolution for submission to the shareholders; the board must adopt the proposal of dissolution and then the shareholders must approve it (generally by a majority of the votes entitled to be cast, unless the articles or the board require a greater vote). After approval, the corporation files articles of dissolution with the secretary of state (RMBCA §14.03). Passage by the board of a resolution to dissolve is therefore a required step.

Approval by the officers is not required; officers carry out the board's decisions but have no role in authorizing dissolution. Amendment of the certificate of incorporation is not required; dissolution is effected by filing articles of dissolution, not by amending the articles of incorporation. A unanimous vote of the stockholders is not required; shareholder approval by the required majority is sufficient.
questions.explanationJa:
RMBCA §14.02 により、任意解散では、まず取締役会が解散案を採択して株主に提出し、株主が承認します（原則として議決権の過半数。定款や取締役会がより多い賛成を求めることも可能）。承認後、州務長官に解散届（articles of dissolution）を提出します（§14.03）。したがって、取締役会による解散決議は必須の手続きです。

役員（officers）の承認は不要で、役員は取締役会の決定を執行するだけです。定款の変更も不要で、解散は解散届の提出によって行います。株主の全員一致も不要で、所定の多数の承認があれば足ります。
